#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add a cover page (title + current date) to report.pdf."""
import datetime
import os
import tempfile

from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas
from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter

INPUT_PDF = "report.pdf"
COVER_PDF = "cover_page.pdf"
TITLE = "Annual Financial Report"

if not os.path.exists(INPUT_PDF):
    raise SystemExit(f"ERROR: {INPUT_PDF} not found in {os.getcwd()}")

today = datetime.date.today()
date_str = today.strftime("%B %d, %Y")

# --- Step 1: Create the cover page ---
c = canvas.Canvas(COVER_PDF, pagesize=letter)
width, height = letter

# Title
c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 28)
c.drawCentredString(width / 2, height - 200, TITLE)

# Current date
c.setFont("Helvetica", 16)
c.drawCentredString(width / 2, height - 250, date_str)

c.save()
print(f"Created cover page: {COVER_PDF}")

# --- Step 2: Merge cover page with report.pdf ---
report_reader = PdfReader(INPUT_PDF)
cover_reader = PdfReader(COVER_PDF)

writer = PdfWriter()
writer.add_page(cover_reader.pages[0])  # Cover page first
for page in report_reader.pages:
    writer.add_page(page)

# Write to temp file then replace original, so report.pdf now includes the cover
fd, tmp_path = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix="report_with_cover_", suffix=".pdf")
os.close(fd)
with open(tmp_path, "wb") as f:
    writer.write(f)
os.replace(tmp_path, INPUT_PDF)

# --- Step 3: Verify the result ---
verify_reader = PdfReader(INPUT_PDF)
first_page_text = verify_reader.pages[0].extract_text() or ""
assert TITLE in first_page_text, f"Verification failed: title not found on cover page"
assert date_str in first_page_text, f"Verification failed: date not found on cover page"
print(f"Verification passed: cover page contains '{TITLE}' and '{date_str}'")

# Clean up the intermediate cover file
os.remove(COVER_PDF)

print(f"Done: {INPUT_PDF} now has {len(verify_reader.pages)} pages "
      f"(1 cover + {len(report_reader.pages)} original).")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add a cover page (title + current date) to report.pdf.

Builds a minimal one-page PDF cover by hand (standard base-14 Helvetica
font, no external dependencies beyond pypdf), prepends it to report.pdf,
and verifies the result.
"""
import datetime
import os
import tempfile

from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter

INPUT_PDF = "report.pdf"
COVER_PDF = "cover_page.pdf"
TITLE = "Annual Financial Report"

PAGE_W = 612.0
PAGE_H = 792.0

# Helvetica glyph widths (per 1000 em) for the characters used on the cover.
HELV = {
    'A': 667, 'B': 667, 'C': 722, 'D': 722, 'E': 667, 'F': 611, 'G': 778,
    'H': 722, 'I': 278, 'J': 500, 'K': 667, 'L': 556, 'M': 833, 'N': 722,
    'O': 778, 'P': 667, 'Q': 778, 'R': 722, 'S': 667, 'T': 611, 'U': 722,
    'V': 667, 'W': 944, 'X': 667, 'Y': 667, 'Z': 611,
    'a': 556, 'b': 556, 'c': 500, 'd': 556, 'e': 556, 'f': 278, 'g': 556,
    'h': 556, 'i': 222, 'j': 222, 'k': 500, 'l': 222, 'm': 833, 'n': 556,
    'o': 556, 'p': 556, 'q': 556, 'r': 333, 's': 500, 't': 278, 'u': 556,
    'v': 500, 'w': 722, 'x': 500, 'y': 500, 'z': 500,
    ' ': 278, ',': 278, '.': 278, '0': 556, '1': 556, '2': 556, '3': 556,
    '4': 556, '5': 556, '6': 556, '7': 556, '8': 556, '9': 556,
}


def text_width(text, font_size):
    return sum(HELV.get(ch, 556) for ch in text) / 1000.0 * font_size


def esc_pdf_string(s):
    return s.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("(", "\\(").replace(")", "\\)")


def build_cover_pdf(path, title, date_str):
    """Write a minimal single-page PDF with a centered title and date."""
    title_font = 28
    date_font = 16
    title_x = (PAGE_W - text_width(title, title_font)) / 2.0
    title_y = 500.0
    gap = 48
    date_x = (PAGE_W - text_width(date_str, date_font)) / 2.0
    date_y = title_y - gap

    content = (
        "BT\n"
        "/F1 %d Tf\n"
        "1 0 0 1 %.2f %.2f Tm\n"
        "(%s) Tj\n"
        "/F1 %d Tf\n"
        "1 0 0 1 %.2f %.2f Tm\n"
        "(%s) Tj\n"
        "ET\n"
    ) % (title_font, title_x, title_y, esc_pdf_string(title),
         date_font, date_x, date_y, esc_pdf_string(date_str))
    content_bytes = content.encode("latin-1")

    objects = [
        b"<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>",
        b"<< /Type /Pages /Kids [3 0 R] /Count 1 >>",
        (b"<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 612 792] "
         b"/Resources << /Font << /F1 4 0 R >> >> /Contents 5 0 R >>"),
        b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica >>",
        (b"<< /Length %d >>\nstream\n" % len(content_bytes)
         + content_bytes + b"\nendstream"),
    ]

    with open(path, "wb") as f:
        f.write(b"%PDF-1.4\n")
        offsets = []
        for i, obj in enumerate(objects, start=1):
            offsets.append(f.tell())
            f.write(b"%d 0 obj\n" % i)
            f.write(obj)
            f.write(b"\nendobj\n")
        xref_pos = f.tell()
        f.write(b"xref\n")
        f.write(b"0 %d\n" % (len(objects) + 1))
        f.write(b"0000000000 65535 f \n")
        for off in offsets:
            f.write(b"%010d 00000 n \n" % off)
        f.write(b"trailer\n<< /Size %d /Root 1 0 R >>\n" % (len(objects) + 1))
        f.write(b"startxref\n%d\n%%%%EOF\n" % xref_pos)


def main():
    if not os.path.exists(INPUT_PDF):
        raise SystemExit("ERROR: %s not found in %s" % (INPUT_PDF, os.getcwd()))

    today = datetime.date.today()
    date_str = today.strftime("%B %d, %Y")
    print("Cover title: %r" % TITLE)
    print("Cover date:  %r" % date_str)

    # --- Step 1: create the cover page ---
    build_cover_pdf(COVER_PDF, TITLE, date_str)
    print("Created cover page: %s" % COVER_PDF)

    # --- Step 2: prepend cover page to report.pdf ---
    report_reader = PdfReader(INPUT_PDF)
    cover_reader = PdfReader(COVER_PDF)
    original_pages = len(report_reader.pages)

    writer = PdfWriter()
    writer.add_page(cover_reader.pages[0])
    for page in report_reader.pages:
        writer.add_page(page)

    fd, tmp_path = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix="report_with_cover_", suffix=".pdf")
    os.close(fd)
    with open(tmp_path, "wb") as f:
        writer.write(f)
    os.replace(tmp_path, INPUT_PDF)

    # --- Step 3: verify ---
    verify_reader = PdfReader(INPUT_PDF)
    first_text = verify_reader.pages[0].extract_text() or ""
    assert TITLE in first_text, "Verification failed: title missing on cover page"
    assert date_str in first_text, "Verification failed: date missing on cover page"
    print("Verification passed: cover page contains %r and %r"
          % (TITLE, date_str))

    os.remove(COVER_PDF)
    print("Done: %s now has %d pages (1 cover + %d original)."
          % (INPUT_PDF, len(verify_reader.pages), original_pages))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Add a cover page (title + current date) to report.pdf."""
import datetime
import os

from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas
from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter

INPUT_PDF = "report.pdf"

    raise SystemExit(f"ERROR: {INPUT_PDF} not found in {os.getcwd()}")

c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 28)
c.drawCentredString(width / 2, height - 200, TITLE)

c.setFont("Helvetica", 16)
c.drawCentredString(width / 2, height - 250, date_str)

report_reader = PdfReader(INPUT_PDF)

for page in report_reader.pages:
    writer.add_page(page)

fd, tmp_path = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix="report_with_cover_", suffix=".pdf")
os.close(fd)
with open(tmp_path, "wb") as f:
    writer.write(f)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add a cover page (title + current date) to report.pdf.

Builds a minimal one-page PDF cover by hand (standard base-14 Helvetica
font, no external dependencies beyond pypdf), prepends it to report.pdf,
and verifies the result.
"""
import datetime
import os
import tempfile

from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter

INPUT_PDF = "report.pdf"
COVER_PDF = "cover_page.pdf"
TITLE = "Annual Financial Report"

PAGE_W = 612.0
PAGE_H = 792.0

# Helvetica glyph widths (per 1000 em) for the characters used on the cover.
HELV = {
    'A': 667, 'B': 667, 'C': 722, 'D': 722, 'E': 667, 'F': 611, 'G': 778,
    'H': 722, 'I': 278, 'J': 500, 'K': 667, 'L': 556, 'M': 833, 'N': 722,
    'O': 778, 'P': 667, 'Q': 778, 'R': 722, 'S': 667, 'T': 611, 'U': 722,
    'V': 667, 'W': 944, 'X': 667, 'Y': 667, 'Z': 611,
    'a': 556, 'b': 556, 'c': 500, 'd': 556, 'e': 556, 'f': 278, 'g': 556,
    'h': 556, 'i': 222, 'j': 222, 'k': 500, 'l': 222, 'm': 833, 'n': 556,
    'o': 556, 'p': 556, 'q': 556, 'r': 333, 's': 500, 't': 278, 'u': 556,
    'v': 500, 'w': 722, 'x': 500, 'y': 500, 'z': 500,
    ' ': 278, ',': 278, '.': 278, '0': 556, '1': 556, '2': 556, '3': 556,
    '4': 556, '5': 556, '6': 556, '7': 556, '8': 556, '9': 556,
}


def text_width(text, font_size):
    return sum(HELV.get(ch, 556) for ch in text) / 1000.0 * font_size


def esc_pdf_string(s):
    return s.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("(", "\\(").replace(")", "\\)")


def build_cover_pdf(path, title, date_str):
    """Write a minimal single-page PDF with a centered title and date."""
    title_font = 28
    date_font = 16
    title_x = (PAGE_W - text_width(title, title_font)) / 2.0
    title_y = 500.0
    gap = 48
    date_x = (PAGE_W - text_width(date_str, date_font)) / 2.0
    date_y = title_y - gap

    content = (
        "BT\n"
        "/F1 %d Tf\n"
        "1 0 0 1 %.2f %.2f Tm\n"
        "(%s) Tj\n"
        "/F1 %d Tf\n"
        "1 0 0 1 %.2f %.2f Tm\n"
        "(%s) Tj\n"
        "ET\n"
    ) % (title_font, title_x, title_y, esc_pdf_string(title),
         date_font, date_x, date_y, esc_pdf_string(date_str))
    content_bytes = content.encode("latin-1")

    objects = [
        b"<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>",
        b"<< /Type /Pages /Kids [3 0 R] /Count 1 >>",
        (b"<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 612 792] "
         b"/Resources << /Font << /F1 4 0 R >> >> /Contents 5 0 R >>"),
        b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica >>",
        (b"<< /Length %d >>\nstream\n" % len(content_bytes)
         + content_bytes + b"\nendstream"),
    ]

    with open(path, "wb") as f:
        f.write(b"%PDF-1.4\n")
        offsets = []
        for i, obj in enumerate(objects, start=1):
            offsets.append(f.tell())
            f.write(b"%d 0 obj\n" % i)
            f.write(obj)
            f.write(b"\nendobj\n")
        xref_pos = f.tell()
        f.write(b"xref\n")
        f.write(b"0 %d\n" % (len(objects) + 1))
        f.write(b"0000000000 65535 f \n")
        for off in offsets:
            f.write(b"%010d 00000 n \n" % off)
        f.write(b"trailer\n<< /Size %d /Root 1 0 R >>\n" % (len(objects) + 1))
        f.write(b"startxref\n%d\n%%%%EOF\n" % xref_pos)


def main():
    if not os.path.exists(INPUT_PDF):
        raise SystemExit("ERROR: %s not found in %s" % (INPUT_PDF, os.getcwd()))

    today = datetime.date.today()
    date_str = today.strftime("%B %d, %Y")
    print("Cover title: %r" % TITLE)
    print("Cover date:  %r" % date_str)

    # --- Step 1: create the cover page ---
    build_cover_pdf(COVER_PDF, TITLE, date_str)
    print("Created cover page: %s" % COVER_PDF)

    # --- Step 2: prepend cover page to report.pdf ---
    report_reader = PdfReader(INPUT_PDF)
    cover_reader = PdfReader(COVER_PDF)
    original_pages = len(report_reader.pages)

    writer = PdfWriter()
    writer.add_page(cover_reader.pages[0])
    for page in report_reader.pages:
        writer.add_page(page)

    fd, tmp_path = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix="report_with_cover_", suffix=".pdf")
    os.close(fd)
    with open(tmp_path, "wb") as f:
        writer.write(f)
    os.replace(tmp_path, INPUT_PDF)

    # --- Step 3: verify ---
    verify_reader = PdfReader(INPUT_PDF)
    first_text = verify_reader.pages[0].extract_text() or ""
    assert TITLE in first_text, "Verification failed: title missing on cover page"
    assert date_str in first_text, "Verification failed: date missing on cover page"
    print("Verification passed: cover page contains %r and %r"
          % (TITLE, date_str))

    os.remove(COVER_PDF)
    print("Done: %s now has %d pages (1 cover + %d original)."
          % (INPUT_PDF, len(verify_reader.pages), original_pages))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
